title: Machine learning predicts DNA-nanotube sensors with strong serotonin response
summary: CNN classifiers and SVM regression models were trained on near-infrared response data for about 100 DNA-SWNT conjugates, and an ensemble of the best of both gave the best predictions of high- and low-response sequences. Validation experiments led to five new DNA-SWNT sensors with a higher fluorescence response to serotonin than obtained previously. Training data were small and per-sequence values were not read.
ai_technology: CNN classifiers and support vector machine regression ensembles predicting DNA sequence optical response
